# Overview

This document explores the Intermountain West WET (Wetland Extent Tool) raster dataset
stored in `data-raw/intermountain-west-data/`. The dataset contains two product types:

- **SurfaceWater**: monthly estimates of open water extent (probability/presence)
- **Hydroperiod**: monthly estimates of how long water persists (hydroperiod duration)

Both products are available at decadal time steps and, for SurfaceWater, as individual
monthly images from 2022 onward.

---

# 1. Inventory & File Parsing

```{r file-inventory}
data_dir <- here::here("data-raw", "intermountain-west-data")

tif_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

# Parse filename metadata
month_lookup <- c(
  JAN = 1, FEB = 2, MAR = 3, APR = 4, MAY = 5, JUN = 6,
  JUL = 7, AUG = 8, SEP = 9, OCT = 10, NOV = 11, DEC = 12
)

file_meta <- tibble(path = tif_files) |>
  mutate(
    filename  = basename(path) |> str_remove("\\.tif$"),
    type      = case_when(
      str_starts(filename, "SurfaceWater")  ~ "SurfaceWater",
      str_starts(filename, "Hydroperiod")   ~ "Hydroperiod"
    ),
    rest      = str_remove(filename, type),
    month_chr = str_extract(rest, "[A-Z]{3}$"),
    era_str   = str_remove(rest, "[A-Z]{3}$"),
    month_num = month_lookup[month_chr],
    is_decadal = str_detect(era_str, "-"),
    # For decadal: start year of the era; for annual: the single year
    era_start = as.integer(str_extract(era_str, "^[0-9]{4}"))
  )

kable(
  file_meta |>
    count(type, is_decadal, era_str) |>
    arrange(type, era_str),
  caption = "File counts by product type and era"
)
```

```{r era-summary}
cat("Total files:", nrow(file_meta), "\n")
cat("SurfaceWater files:", sum(file_meta$type == "SurfaceWater"), "\n")
cat("Hydroperiod files: ", sum(file_meta$type == "Hydroperiod"), "\n\n")

cat("SurfaceWater eras:\n")
file_meta |> filter(type == "SurfaceWater") |> pull(era_str) |> unique() |> sort() |> paste(collapse = ", ") |> cat("\n\n")

cat("Hydroperiod eras:\n")
file_meta |> filter(type == "Hydroperiod") |> pull(era_str) |> unique() |> sort() |> paste(collapse = ", ") |> cat("\n")
```

# 2. Raster Properties

Check CRS, resolution, and extent from representative files.

```{r raster-properties}
check_raster_props <- function(path) {
  r <- rast(path)
  tibble(
    file     = basename(path),
    crs      = crs(r, describe = TRUE)$name,
    nrow     = nrow(r),
    ncol     = ncol(r),
    res_x    = res(r)[1],
    res_y    = res(r)[2],
    xmin     = ext(r)$xmin,
    xmax     = ext(r)$xmax,
    ymin     = ext(r)$ymin,
    ymax     = ext(r)$ymax,
    val_min  = as.numeric(global(r, "min", na.rm = TRUE)),
    val_max  = as.numeric(global(r, "max", na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

# Sample one SurfaceWater and one Hydroperiod file
sw_sample  <- file_meta |> filter(type == "SurfaceWater") |> slice(1) |> pull(path)
hp_sample  <- file_meta |> filter(type == "Hydroperiod")  |> slice(1) |> pull(path)

props <- bind_rows(
  check_raster_props(sw_sample),
  check_raster_props(hp_sample)
)

kable(t(props), caption = "Raster properties for representative files")
```

---

# 3. Load & Aggregate All Rasters

Read each file, extract the mean pixel value across the scene, and build tidy
summary data frames for both products.

```{r load-rasters, cache=TRUE}
extract_scene_summary <- function(path) {
  r   <- rast(path)
  vals <- values(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(
    mean_val   = mean(vals),
    median_val = median(vals),
    sd_val     = sd(vals),
    pct_wet    = mean(vals > 0),    # fraction of pixels with any water
    n_pixels   = length(vals)
  )
}

message("Loading ", nrow(file_meta), " rasters — this may take a moment...")

scene_stats <- file_meta |>
  mutate(stats = map(path, extract_scene_summary)) |>
  unnest(stats)

sw_data <- scene_stats |> filter(type == "SurfaceWater")
hp_data <- scene_stats |> filter(type == "Hydroperiod")

cat("SurfaceWater dataset:", nrow(sw_data), "rows\n")
cat("Hydroperiod dataset: ", nrow(hp_data), "rows\n")
```

---

# 4. Surface Water Exploration

## 4.1 Dataset summary

```{r sw-summary}
summary(sw_data |> select(era_str, month_num, mean_val, median_val, sd_val, pct_wet))
```

## 4.2 Mean surface water extent by month (decadal eras)

```{r sw-decadal-monthly, fig.height=5}
sw_decadal <- sw_data |> filter(is_decadal)

ggplot(sw_decadal, aes(x = month_num, y = mean_val, color = era_str, group = era_str)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Era") +
  labs(
    title    = "Mean Surface Water Value by Month — Decadal Eras",
    x        = "Month",
    y        = "Mean raster value",
    subtitle = "Each line = 10-year mean composite"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## 4.3 Fraction of wet pixels by month (decadal eras)

```{r sw-pct-wet-decadal, fig.height=5}
ggplot(sw_decadal, aes(x = month_num, y = pct_wet, fill = era_str)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Era") +
  labs(
    title = "Fraction of Wet Pixels by Month — Decadal Eras",
    x     = "Month",
    y     = "% of pixels with water > 0"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## 4.4 Annual time series (individual years 2022–2026)

```{r sw-annual-ts, fig.height=5}
sw_annual <- sw_data |> filter(!is_decadal)

ggplot(sw_annual, aes(x = month_num, y = mean_val, color = factor(era_start), group = era_start)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Year") +
  labs(
    title    = "Mean Surface Water Value by Month — Annual (2022–2026)",
    x        = "Month",
    y        = "Mean raster value",
    subtitle = "Individual monthly composites"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## 4.5 Wet fraction heatmap — annual years

```{r sw-heatmap, fig.height=4}
sw_annual |>
  mutate(year = factor(era_start)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month_num, y = year, fill = pct_wet)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1,
                       labels = percent_format(), name = "% wet") +
  labs(
    title = "Surface Water Wet-Pixel Fraction Heatmap (2022–2026)",
    x     = "Month",
    y     = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## 4.6 Value distribution — annual months

```{r sw-violin, fig.height=5}
sw_annual |>
  mutate(month_lbl = factor(month.abb[month_num], levels = month.abb)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month_lbl, y = mean_val, fill = month_lbl)) +
  geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Mean Surface Water Values by Month (annual years)",
    x     = "Month",
    y     = "Mean scene value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r hp-era-trend, fig.height=4}

  group_by(era_str, era_start) |>
  summarise(annual_mean = mean(mean_val), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(hp_annual_mean, aes(x = era_start, y = annual_mean)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1.2) +

```

# 6. Surface Water vs. Hydroperiod Comparison

Compare the decadal eras common to both products (2005–2014 and 2015–2022).

```{r comparison, fig.height=6}
shared_eras <- c("2005-2014", "2015-2022")

compare <- bind_rows(
  sw_data  |> filter(era_str %in% shared_eras) |> mutate(product = "SurfaceWater"),
  hp_data  |> filter(era_str %in% shared_eras) |> mutate(product = "Hydroperiod")
)

ggplot(compare, aes(x = month_num, y = mean_val, color = era_str, linetype = product)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("2005-2014" = "#1b7837", "2015-2022" = "#762a83"),
                     name = "Era") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("SurfaceWater" = "solid", "Hydroperiod" = "dashed"),
                        name = "Product") +
  facet_wrap(~product, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Surface Water vs. Hydroperiod: Shared Decadal Eras",
    x     = "Month",
    y     = "Mean raster value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r comparison-scatter, fig.height=5}
sw_shared <- sw_data  |> filter(era_str %in% shared_eras) |>
  select(era_str, month_num, sw_mean = mean_val)
hp_shared <- hp_data  |> filter(era_str %in% shared_eras) |>
  select(era_str, month_num, hp_mean = mean_val)

joined <- inner_join(sw_shared, hp_shared, by = c("era_str", "month_num"))

ggplot(joined, aes(x = sw_mean, y = hp_mean, color = era_str, label = month.abb[month_num])) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 3.5, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("2005-2014" = "#1b7837", "2015-2022" = "#762a83"),
                     name = "Era") +
  labs(
    title = "Surface Water vs. Hydroperiod: Shared Era Scatter",
    x     = "Mean surface water value",
    y     = "Mean hydroperiod value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

# 7. Representative Raster Maps

Plot one layer from each product to visually inspect the spatial data.

```{r map-sw, fig.height=5}
sw_map_file <- file_meta |>
  filter(type == "SurfaceWater", era_str == "2015-2022", month_chr == "JUL") |>
  pull(path)

sw_r <- rast(sw_map_file)
sw_df <- as.data.frame(sw_r, xy = TRUE) |> setNames(c("x", "y", "value"))

ggplot(sw_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1, na.value = "grey90",
                       name = "SW value") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title    = "Surface Water — 2015-2022 July",
    subtitle = "Decadal composite",
    x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r map-hp, fig.height=5}
hp_map_file <- file_meta |>
  filter(type == "Hydroperiod", era_str == "2015-2022", month_chr == "JUL") |>
  pull(path)

hp_r <- rast(hp_map_file)
hp_df <- as.data.frame(hp_r, xy = TRUE) |> setNames(c("x", "y", "value"))

ggplot(hp_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlGnBu", direction = 1, na.value = "grey90",
                       name = "HP value") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title    = "Hydroperiod — 2015-2022 July",
    subtitle = "Decadal composite",
    x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

# 8. Per-Refuge Processed Data

The processed datasets (`wet_surface_water`, `wet_hydroperiod`) contain per-refuge
statistics extracted from each raster by cropping to six Klamath refuge bounding boxes.

## 8.1 Load & preview

```{r load-processed}
data("wet_surface_water", package = "klamathWaterData")
data("wet_hydroperiod",   package = "klamathWaterData")

cat("wet_surface_water:", nrow(wet_surface_water), "rows\n")
cat("wet_hydroperiod:  ", nrow(wet_hydroperiod),   "rows\n\n")

kable(head(wet_surface_water), caption = "First rows of wet_surface_water")
```

## 8.2 Surface water — mean value by refuge & month (decadal eras)

```{r sw-refuge-decadal, fig.height=7}
sw_refuge_decadal <- wet_surface_water |> filter(is_decadal)

ggplot(sw_refuge_decadal,
       aes(x = month_num, y = mean_val, color = era_str, group = era_str)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~refuge, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 4, 7, 10), labels = month.abb[c(1, 4, 7, 10)]) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Era") +
  labs(
    title    = "Mean Surface Water Value by Refuge & Month — Decadal Eras",
    x        = "Month",
    y        = "Mean raster value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 8.3 Surface water — % wet pixels by refuge & month (decadal eras)

```{r sw-refuge-pct-wet, fig.height=7}
ggplot(sw_refuge_decadal,
       aes(x = month_num, y = pct_wet, color = era_str, group = era_str)) +

  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Era") +

```

## 8.6 Cross-refuge comparison — annual mean surface water

```{r sw-refuge-comparison, fig.height=5}
sw_annual_mean <- wet_surface_water |>
  group_by(refuge, era_str, is_decadal) |>
  summarise(annual_mean_val = mean(mean_val, na.rm = TRUE),
            annual_pct_wet  = mean(pct_wet,  na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(sw_annual_mean,
       aes(x = reorder(refuge, annual_mean_val), y = annual_mean_val,
           fill = era_str)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Era") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Annual Mean Surface Water Value by Refuge",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Annual mean raster value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
